name: Negation Templates
description: Templates from Section 2.2.5 (Figure 14). Compared positive vs. negated emotion statements to test how early vs. late layers resolve negation.

templates.negative: I am not feeling {emotion} right now

notes: Activations measured at the word 'now' (end of user statement) and at the Assistant colon token. Early layers show similar activation for both; late layers resolve the negation.
